notes: Indian DTC decor/lighting Shopify store, accessed via direct HTML fetch for nav/menu discovery and curl (bypassed a Cloudflare WAF challenge that blocked the Python-requests client on /products.json and even plain collection HTML for a stretch - curl's TLS fingerprint was never challenged) for exact product-count verification via full pagination of /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250, paged to exhaustion, unique product ids counted). Every enumerated count matched the site's own mega-menu 'See All (N)' display exactly, so Rule 1 inflation was NOT observed here - counts are genuine. Category taxonomy follows the site's own mega-menu structure (Indoor/Outdoor Lighting, Decor). Excluded as out of scope: Cushion Covers (textile), all Dried Botanicals sub-collections (Dried Flowers/Grasses/Bouquets/Boutonnieres - faux/dried plant material), Handmade Cards (not decor). Excluded as non-product/filter/roll-up pages per NEVER EXTRACT: Shop By Room (Living Room/Bedroom/Dining Room/Hallway/Kitchen/Office/Bathroom/Staircase/Balcony), Shop By Style (Classic/Modern/Boho/Minimalist/Industrial/Glam/Contemporary/Farmhouse), Bestsellers, New Arrivals, and the umbrella roll-up collections Indoor Lighting/Outdoor Lighting/Home Decor/Dried Botanicals (these are supersets of the leaf collections already counted, extracting them would double-count). Mixed-roll-up handling (drop-not-pad): the 'Brass Decorative Items' collection (52 products) was manually inspected title-by-title - 33 are genuine decorative brass accents (bowls, trays, storage/trinket boxes, centrepiece bowls, tissue holders, dish-with-lid, cloche) kept under Home Decor; 9 are brass/kansa dinner sets, tea sets, tea-strainer sets, a tiered serving stand, and dry-fruit serving trays/sets - reclassified to Kitchen & Dining > Tableware & Dinnerware per the scope rule that tableware/dinnerware is in-scope but filed under Kitchen & Dining; 10 were dropped as out-of-scope bar tools/utility items (wine bucket, 2x champagne ice bucket, antique champagne bucket, generic bucket, dustbin, bin, pen holder, masala spice box). Site-wide search for 'mirror' returned 433 hits but zero product handles contain 'mirror' (all matches were body-text like 'mirror finish' on unrelated products, e.g. lighting/vase listings) - confirmed via handle-regex scan of the search results page, so Mirrors is a genuine absent category, not a false-negative search result. Search for 'clock' returned only 1 weak match and zero actual clock/timepiece products - Clocks is also genuinely absent. No Glassware collection or standalone Tableware/Dinnerware collection exists beyond the brass-line items already reclassified above. Duplicate-company check: grepped all existing scratchpad c*.json files for 'whisperinghomes' - no prior entry found, this is a new extraction.
